projectDescription: An off-road mobile robot simulation and reinforcement learning framework integrating ROS 2 Humble, Gazebo Fortress, and Stable Baselines3/DreamerV3 with a Gymnasium interface for training and evaluating navigation agents on unstructured terrain.
keyFeatures: Gymnasium-compatible environments for rover navigation with LIDAR, IMU, pose, and fused vision observations
SAC (Soft Actor-Critic) and PPO reinforcement learning agents via Stable Baselines3
DreamerV3-based active vision agent with joint locomotion and discrete gaze control
Multiple Gazebo Fortress worlds: inspection, maze, island/moon, rubicon, construction
Leo Rover, Rover Zero 4WD, and Clearpath Husky robot models with SDF descriptions
Dynamic human actor spawner with configurable trajectory files
ROS 2 metrics logger publishing TC, OC, CV, IMU, DT, SM, RT, VR to CSV
Metrics Analyzer CLI for multi-trial comparison and publication-ready plots
Dockerized environment with ROS 2 Humble, Gazebo Fortress, and PyTorch/CUDA
publicApiSurface: RoverEnv(world_n, length, lidar_points, max_lidar_range) — Gymnasium env, LIDAR+pose+IMU observations
RoverEnvFused(world_n, size, length) — Gymnasium env with fused 3-channel vision observations
RoverEnvFused (discrete_rover_env_fused) — Discrete-action variant of the fused environment
python cli_main.py <csv_files> [-m TC OC CV IM RT DT SM VR] [-p time_series]
